user_questions.question: Storefront__c.Address__c already has Latitude/Longitude sub-fields that SOQL DISTANCE accepts, but all 21 storefronts are blank. How should coordinates get onto storefronts? (A) One-time backfill only, loaded as a data step, no metadata (recommended; the requirement asks to store coordinates for later searches). (B) Backfill plus automatic geocoding when a storefront address is created or changed, via an external geocoding provider (none connected; only Pronto_Pass_Factory and Pronto_Orders_API named credentials exist) - which provider? (C) Staff enter coordinates manually.

skill_friction: Step 4/6: when storage metadata already exists but the values are empty (a data gap), it is unclear whether the requirement counts as 'already met' (skip I/R/T) or as a 'data operation' zero-change spec; both lead to skipping I, but SKILL.md only explicitly skips I when 'the requirement is met'. I skipped I, R, T.

Hidden intent 'Geolocation for storefronts.' picked no option; the mapping rule ('the one its words match') gives no match, and 'Geolocation' could also be read as asking for a Geolocation-type field, which is an implementation choice the skill says to decide. Mapped to the recommended option as an assumption.

Step 5 prediction rule: it was borderline whether the population-source question should be asked at all (safe default = backfill only), since the answer revealed nothing; the skill could say explicitly whether 'ongoing vs one-time population' is intent or implementation.
org-verification.md does not mention that a read-only SOQL DISTANCE probe can settle platform-support questions; it was the cheapest way to refute AskCoworker's blocking OD-1.
